profile.headline: Technical advisor with Space RCO
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the Defense & Space industry. Skilled in project design, object oriented design. Focus in C++, and cross-platform development. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Science - BS focused in Computer Software Engineering from University of New Mexico School of Engineering.

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description: Moved up from a Junior to Full Title Position
positions.insights: Skills: Code Review · C++ · C# · DevOps · Gitlab · Python (Programming Language) · Git · Agile Project Management · HTML5 · HTML · Web Technologies · C (Programming Language)

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description: As a Web Developer, gained valuable practical hands-on experience and relevant insights into both Agile and Scrum development processes. Learned critical value of taking requirements from clients and proper database design. Restructured front end of several apps for better design and maintenance, earning the Diamond Award of Excellence. During app restructure, received Civilian of the Quarter Award for serving the youth as a spiritual leader and serving orphanage among stellar work and personal productivity.

positions.title: Mobile App Developer
positions.description:
*In partnership with educational development company - Quanser

Learned the basics of mobile development and effective design. Elected making a problem solver and random generation of problems instead of a limited pool to improve an app’s effect on the end user. Benefited in several apps development by improving designs and efficiency of the platform. Mostly independent and remote work, met weekly with mentor for review of progress verification and validation

honors.title: Civilian of the Quarter - Category 1
honors.description: During app restructure and earning the Diamond Award, received Civilian of the Quarter Award for serving the youth as a spiritual leader and serving orphanage among stellar work and personal productivity. Completing a bachelors of science in computer engineering, and completing the upper level coursework with a 3.72 GPA. Also, improving the degree program by creating useful educational tools, and suggesting edits to certain courses.
honors.issuer: Issued by Dr. Mark Harris · Mar 2017

honors.title: Diamond Award of Excellence
honors.description: Initialized restructuring front end of several apps for much better design and future maintenance. This effort became the standard for further development for the entire project.
honors.issuer: Issued by Dr. Mark Harris · Feb 2017
